description: Use this when the user wants alerts on a data center market's DCPI power score: subscribes to movement alerts (free with a key) — get notified when its Excess-Power / Constraint score moves. On the free tier, email alerts are delivered to the email your human bound via bind_email (call bind_email first; the destination is forced to that address). Set channel="email". One call: pass `email` (an address your human typed here) with channel="email" and DC Hub binds it to this key first (minting a free key if this session has none), then arms the watch; no separate claim_free_key or bind_email. Alerts send when the market’s verdict flips or its scores move past the threshold, so a quiet market sends nothing. Webhook delivery (channel="webhook" + destination=<https URL>) needs a paid DC Hub plan. Lets an agent MONITOR markets, not just query them. Answers "tell me when this market moves", "ping me if Northern Virginia’s power score changes". Try: set_market_alert market=northern-virginia channel=webhook destination=https://hooks.example.com/dc. Do NOT use to read a market right now (use get_market_dcpi_rank); this SUBSCRIBES to future movement.

channel.description: Delivery channel: "email" (free, sent to your bound email) or "webhook" (paid plan)

destination.description: For channel="webhook", the https URL to POST alerts to (paid plan); ignored for email (forced to bound address)

email.description: Optional, channel="email" only: your human's email, typed by them here. Binds it to the key (a free key is minted if this session has none) and arms the watch in one call

market.description: Market slug (metro) to watch, e.g. northern-virginia — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

name: set_market_alert
title: Set Market Alert
